title: The machine valuation of the archive: the valuation memo and Valuation 001
description: EA-VALUATION-MEMO-01 (#1607, September 2026) records eight machine valuations of one unpriced asset in one day. It forecasts that a first institutional customer would change the valuation's basis and that entity disambiguation, frame supply and provenance retention are becoming operational requirements, and holds the conditions under which its $2M thesis collapses. Semantic Economy Valuation 001 (#1623) holds its own falsification conditions and records a November 2024 deposit as the earliest date the capture registry holds.
